    Pins in use
    
      
    
        
    
          
    Button A (yellow)board.GP0Reads False when pressed
    
          
    Button B (blue)board.GP1Reads False when pressed
    
          
    Knobboard.GP28analogio.AnalogIn, 0–65535
    
          
    Buzzerboard.GP8pwmio.PWMOut or simpleio.tone
    
          
    RGB LEDsboard.GP14neopixel.NeoPixel(board.GP14, 5)
    
          
    Pico LEDboard.LEDdigitalio.DigitalInOut
    
        
    
        
    Modules: board, digitalio, analogio, pwmio, neopixel, simpleio, rainbowio, time, random, math.
